verdict.rationale: Fern documents a local preview server with hot reload (fern-docs-14/26/39) but there is no evidence of automatic, shareable preview deployment URLs generated per pull request (e.g., a bot comment with a live link tied to CI/CD on PR open). This is a local-only workflow rather than a hosted PR-preview link. missing for 10: PR-triggered hosted preview deployment, shareable preview URL per PR, CI/CD integration or bot comment posting preview links, independent confirmation of PR-preview behavior.
